text.en:
Repealing Clause. All laws, decrees, acts,
orders, proclamations, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity.
immediately.
This Executive Order shall take effect
DONE in the City of Manila, this 25th
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-seven.
day of July , in
By the President:
JOKER P. ARRUIO
Executive Secretary
